title: Uposatha (3)
text: 12 Sāvatthi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacce saṃsedajā nāgā uposatham upavasanti ossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti || || 4-6 Sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ || || 7 Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo || yenamidhekacce saṃsedajā nāgā uposatham upavasanti ossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti.
